fields.mutation_checks: run with private tooling that applies one exact replacement, runs the host's filtered library tests and restores the file; the specifications, results and runners are attached to the batch35-source and batch35-source-2 stages. Nine single Rust mutations on the source tree of 5f955cad: eight were caught; M2, which drops RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS from the folder open, survived, because O_NOFOLLOW already refuses a link as the folder itself. A test through an absolute link in an earlier component did not catch it either (RESOLVE_BENEATH refuses absolute links); a test through a relative link in an earlier component did. With both tests, committed as 58657604, all nine were caught: an unchecked quote, links followed, folder privacy unchecked, a boundary that allows any tool, cards for an unverified run, a repeated request sequence, re-admission while a run is pinned, a statementless answer admitted and an admission digest that is not bound. The files were verified restored afterwards
